def VTask.evenOddRec {P : ℕ → Sort u_1}
  (h0 : P 0)
  (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n))
  (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1))
  (n : ℕ) : P n :=
  Nat.lt_wf.fix (fun self n => P n) (fun n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => h0
    | m + 1 =>
      let k := (m + 1) / 2
      let hk : k < m + 1 := Nat.div_lt_self (Nat.succ_pos m) Nat.two_lt
      if (m + 1) % 2 == 0 then
        h_even k (ih k hk)
      else
        h_odd k (ih k hk)
  ) n
